hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f" 2>/dev/null || true; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; [ -n "$f" ] && case "$f" in *.ts|*.js|*.mjs|*.cjs) npx eslint --fix "$f" 2>/dev/null || true;; esac; }
